findings.body: The holder is launched by executing an extensionless Python script directly. Windows cannot execute its shebang, so this raises an OSError before any recovery assertions run. The suite includes Windows runners (.github/workflows/forge-next.yml:23), and the harness explicitly handles Windows script launching (tests/conftest.py:50). Launch the holder with `sys.executable` followed by the script path, as the test already does for Forge.
